name: 收入会计核算 - 石油和天然气生产 (5NM)
name_en: Revenue Accounting – Oil and Gas Production (5NM)
description_en_html:
Overview

SAP Production and Revenue Accounting integrates production volume allocations, division order management, sales contract allocations, volume pricing and valuation, royalty and working interest owner revenue distribution, payment processing, and state and federal reporting and compliance to provide a comprehensive solution that enables upstream oil and gas companies to efficiently manage their vital revenue accounting processes.

Key Process Flow

  • Production Processing
  • Ownership Management
  • Contractual Allocations/Balancing
  • Valuation/Revenue Distribution
  • Finance Interface
  • Payment Processing
  • Tax Reporting
  • ONRR/State Royalty Reporting

The below functional enhancements are included in the Production and Revenue Accounting (PRA) from the SAP S/4HANA 2025 FPS01 release.

  • The legacy PPN extension provides enhancement to handle data in legacy systems through the accounting documents and provides functionality to perform valuation reversals.

  • Multiple scenarios to cater to gross enhancement requirements.

  • Integration of PRA payments to Treasury.

  • Enhancements to the Accounts Receivable workplace and the Production Payment desktop have made these transactions more user-friendly and have introduced the ability for mass processing.

  • SAP Document AI for PRA plant statements is currently available to customers during the beta phase.

  • Royalty reports for Alaska and tax reports for Montana and West Virginia, ensuring that these reports are created using the application suite.

  • New mass uploads for the chemical analysis point transaction.

Business Benefits

  • Create one common identification of a well to associate with volume, value, and tax information
  • Execute a complete accounting close cycle from volume collection to financial posting as one contiguous process
  • Track and instantly apply division order, volume, and price changes as prior period adjustments
  • Run processes such as royalty payments, tax and royalty compliance reporting, and others in a step-wise common execution framework
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP Production and Revenue Accounting 集成了生产量分配、部门订单管理、销售合同分配、数量定价和评估、版税和工作利息所有者收入分配、付款处理以及州和联邦报告与合规性，以提供全面的解决方案，使上游石油和天然气公司能够高效管理其重要的收入会计核算流程。

关键流程流

  • 生产处理
  • 所有权管理
  • 合同分配/结算
  • 评估/收入分配
  • 财务界面
  • 付款处理
  • 税务报表
  • ONRR/State 特许权报告

以下功能增强包含在 SAP S/4HANA 2025 FPS01 版本的生产和收入会计核算 (PRA) 中。

  • 历史 PPN 扩展通过会计凭证提供处理历史系统中数据的增强，并提供执行评估冲销的功能。

  • 满足总增强要求的多个场景。

  • 将 PRA 付款集成到资金。

  • 增强了应收账款工作区和生产付款桌面，使这些交易更加用户友好，并引入了批量处理的功能。

  • 目前，在 beta 阶段，客户可以使用面向 PRA 工厂报表的 SAP Document AI。

  • 阿拉斯加的版税报表和蒙大拿州和西弗吉尼亚州的税务报表，确保使用应用程序套件创建这些报表。

  • 化学品分析点事务的新批量上载。

业务优势

  • 创建井的通用标识，以便与数量、价值和税收信息相关联
  • 作为一个连续的流程，执行从批量收集到财务过账的完整会计关账周期
  • 跟踪并立即应用产品组订单、数量和价格更改作为前期调整
  • 在逐步通用的执行框架中运行诸如特许权付款、税收和版税合规性报表等流程
